data.name: OVERTYPE
data.detailed_description:
Overtype is a roguelike typing action game set in a neon-soaked cyberpunk city ruled by a totalitarian regime.
You play as Zyra, one of the few survivors immune to the system’s neural control armed with nothing but your keyboard.

Every action you take moving, attacking, dodging, reloading, using abilities is done by typing the words and commands displayed on screen in real time.
Miss a letter, and you might lose a life. Type with precision and speed, and you’ll turn every keystroke into a weapon of rebellion.

A Neon Post-Apocalypse

Beneath the dazzling neon lights lies a city shattered by control where humans and machines are bound by code and fear.
You play as Zyra, one of the few who can walk through corrupted data zones. Guided by Orpheus, a battle-scarred veteran, she seeks the truth about her parents scientists who left behind humanity’s last spark of hope.

⚡ Typing Combat

Overtype is a roguelike typing action game where every action is performed by typing the words shown on screen.
Type to move, attack, reload, and unleash abilities.
Every word is a bullet; every typo could mean your death.

🔁 Dynamic Progression

Each run brings new word sequences, enemies, and upgrades.
Defeat unlocks fragments of memory that reveal Zyra’s past and enhance her power for the next attempt.

💀 Boss Encounters

Face off against Archon’s elite commanders, cyborg generals, rogue AIs, and towering bio-mecha in high-intensity battles that test both reflexes and strategy.

💫 Type Your Future

Everything in Overtype combat, movement, interaction is controlled through typing the words you see on screen.
Master the rhythm of your keystrokes and rewrite humanity’s fate, one letter at a time.

data.short_description: Overtype is a roguelike typing action game set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse. Type to fight, dodge, and survive against waves of cyborgs and corrupted machines. Every keystroke is your weapon master speed and precision to uncover Zyra’s legacy and type out humanity’s last hope.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 @ 3.1 GHz or AMD FX-6300 @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 670 or AMD R9 270 (2GB VRAM with Shader Model 5.0 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Only runs on 64 bit systems
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 @ 3.4 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1600 @ 3.2 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD R9 290X (4GB VRAM with Shader Model 5.0 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Only runs on 64 bit systems
